title: Supplier platform
suppliersDescription: Create, configure and disable suppliers; manage supply scope and resource limits.
accountsDescription: Manage supplier accounts with shared authorization, quotas and scheduling.
proxiesDescription: Manage supplier proxies with shared pool and portal status.
usageDescription: Review request usage and list-price costs by supplier, account, model and date.
settlementsDescription: Generate statements from usage and contracts, then record completed external payments.
name: Name
dateHint: UTC dates; start inclusive, end exclusive.
paymentHint: Record a completed external payment only. No transfer is initiated. Check the amount and reference.
confirmAction: This updates the supplier portal and resource state. Please confirm.
supplierEditorHint: Create the login and supplier together. Policies and settlement details are shared with the portal.
limitHint: 0 means unlimited; children cannot exceed a finite parent limit.
accountCreationHint: Create an account and paired VM for this supplier. Complete authorization from the account row afterward.
proxyCreationHint: The proxy belongs to the selected supplier. Credentials are used by the backend; lists show a redacted endpoint.
settlementHint: The platform settles with tier 1, including direct children’s usage. Tier 1 manages downstream settlement.
unpricedWarning: {{count}} requests are unpriced. Settlement is blocked until pricing is complete.
confirmStatementHint: This updates the shared statement. Check the period and amount.
pricingHelp: Effective at 00:00 Beijing time. The latest version wins on the same effective date. Billing periods are split across changes. Applies to all suppliers; issued bills are not recalculated.
pricingCalculationBasis: Pricing is selected by usage time and split at effective dates. Issued bills retain their original snapshot.

pricingDescription: One pricing schedule for all suppliers, selected by the time usage occurred.
pricingNoCurrent: No global rule is currently effective
pricingLegacyNoLines: This historical bill has no saved pricing breakdown.
pricingEmpty: No global pricing yet. Complete the four fields above.
searchProxy: Search proxy name, endpoint or supplier
archiveConfirm: Archive this proxy? It will no longer be assigned to new accounts.
proxyWorkbenchHint: Changes are synchronized with the shared proxy pool; bound accounts reload when required.
proxyCredentialHint: Credentials are stored by the backend and passwords are never shown in the list.
proxyEditEndpointHint: Leave blank to keep the current proxy; use the socks5://user:password@host:1080 format when changing it.
